en: The image shows a waterfront scene with a large, white, modernist-style building near a harbor or marina. Small boats and sailboats are docked or sailing in the water. In the foreground, there is a well-maintained public garden with palm trees, bushes, and walking paths. In the background, green hills are visible across the water. The scene is sunlit and appears to be from a temperate or warm coastal region. There is no visible printed text on the front of the postcard.
